title: Adding a dependency to an archived task writes a duplicate record beside the archive
body: changeDependency has no archive guard (editTask has one, store.ts:528-531), so it writes tasks/<id>.json beside tasks/archive/*.jsonl and checkTaskDirectory fails (src/task/store.ts:591-626).

Evidence: an external Gemini audit (2026-11-20) wrote the reproduction .krn/runs/gemini-audit/d8-*.test.ts; it fails by assertion on main 1856e2d, and an independent krn-reader pass confirmed the premise and the expected behaviour against the source.
Outcome: the reproduction becomes the regression test at the lowest layer that shows the defect (KRN-14) and passes; the fix names the defect class in Root cause and Redesign lines (KRN-15).

Files: src/task/store.ts, test/task/store.test.ts
Proof: node --test .krn/runs/gemini-audit/d8-task-dep-corrupts-archive.test.ts fails by assertion on the base and passes after the fix
